title: Interface-engineered N-doped carbon dot/CdSe nanoconjugates as efficient Bi-functional electrocatalysts in alkaline media
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17905-17917
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00371K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rituparna Dutta, Gokul Sivaguru, Uday Kumar Ghorui, Aswathi Mangalasseri, Sabyasachi Chakrabortty
A novel nanocomposite with CQDs and CdSe demonstrated overpotential of 99 mV and 170 mV for HER and OER at 10 mA cm−2, respectively with prolonged stability for 50 h. The CQDs/CdSe nanocomposite renders cell potential of 1.77 V at 10 mA cm−2 for OWS.
